difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if A and B are Tor independent R-algebras then the object E of the tensor product equation is zero, and in that case L_{A tensor_R B/R} decomposes as the direct sum of the two base changed cotangent complexes, represented by L_{A/R} tensor_R B (+) L_{B/R} tensor_R A (source lines 3037-3049). The proof derives the first two statements from the flat base change lemma for the cotangent complex, and the representation statement from the fact that L_{A/R} is a complex of free A-modules, so that the derived tensor product with A tensor_R B is represented by the ordinary tensor product L_{A/R} tensor_R B.
